prompt_text: Who was the first president of Brazil?
response_text: The first president of Brazil was **Manuel Deodoro da Fonseca**. He became president after the proclamation of the Republic on November 15 1889 and served as head of state from 1889 until his resignation in November 1891. (He had previously been a marshal in the Brazilian army and played a key role in the military coup that ended the imperial monarchy.)
